baseline.normalization: Finite nonzero vectors and current MemoryStore cosine; no truncation.

candidate.normalization: Native 768 dimensions, finite nonzero vectors, cosine; no padding or dimension truncation.
candidate.digestDisposition: Resolve after explicit provisioning and pin before scoring; missing identity yields HOLD.

rejection.rule: Accept returned top-five hybrid rows only when their maximum cosine with the actual query vector meets the threshold.

retrieval.storageRoot: Unique disposable root per model/run; never production memory.db or cache.

measurement.lease: Exclusive run lease; overlapping runs refuse.
measurement.offlineEvidence: Process-level blocked non-loopback ordinary inference, separate from provisioning downloads.

gate.unmeasuredTierDisposition: HOLD; retain default and withhold catalog/index changes
gate.termsDisposition: HOLD pending pinned checkpoint distribution terms and prohibited-use-policy discrepancy
gate.contextDisposition: 8K model-card supported budget; 256K listing does not permit taking the 32K Qwen job

referenceHost.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti Laptop GPU

resourceCeilings.evaluationRamSource: Engineering evaluation bound equal to the most restrictive existing DEFAULT_MEMORY_BUDGETS.maxCacheRamGB, not a new embedding product policy.
resourceCeilings.coexistenceSource: Conservative reference-host workingMemReserveGB=2 from diffusion-high policy.
resourceCeilings.processRamPeakDisposition: Not proven by five diagnostic calls; instrument or HOLD in Phase2.

imageRecipe.sourceCeilingSource: Current generated-media dimension cap; restored-image decode is currently unbounded and Phase5 must enforce this engineering contract.
imageRecipe.history: Full retained history/cursor; typed limit refusal, never prune; branch redo only after committed new edit.
imageRecipe.authorization: Explicit owned-image grant bound to authenticated caller, coding session/run, image ids and source hash. Shared token and workspace-root union are insufficient.
imageRecipe.grantIssuer: Human UI image selection/confirmation through existing action-tier/permission owners.
imageRecipe.deletion: Transactional recipe cascade in sessions.db with session/turn owner; preserve other images and original-media ownership.
imageRecipe.persistence: Existing StudioSessionStore connection/lifecycle; no second SQLite connection.
